'''Vulture Squad''' was an armored unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Military]] present during the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|battle]] for [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in [[3627 BBY]]. Amongst its ranks were heavy [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]. Such walkers included [[Armor Unit 02]] and [[Armor Unit 14]], which were destroyed by the [[Eternal Alliance]]'s [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] during the battle.
